cn.t: This intimate recovery group drama earns praise for its elegant structure and strong ensemble performances, but critics find Perkins' time-shifting narrative frustratingly opaque and overworked, leaving many confused despite its tender intentions.

vr.q: It's the kind of piece that invites projection, enabling different people to take away different things from it and apply their own interpretations.
